description: This file defines a utility class `DatabaseIndexMapper` in the `org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.core.service.database` package. Its purpose is to extract index details from a SQL result set (`SqlRowSet`) and convert them into a list of `IndexDetail` objects.

classes.name: DatabaseIndexMapper
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for mapping database index information from SQL result sets.

methods.name: getIndexDetails
methods.description: Retrieves a list of index details from the provided SqlRowSet, assuming the index name or similar detail is in the first column.
